about: Voltaire's identity parts and the selection this site shows. tools/identity.py checks the page against this file and builds the repository artwork from it. The page never reads it: it is an authoring record, not a runtime setting. A file suffix names the theme a part is drawn for, not the part's color.

pyramid-point-down.description: Three stacked plates, each overlapping the next, and a separate cap that meets the stack at a single point and overlaps nothing. Drawn point down.

deconstructed.treatment: The continuous lettering with parts cut away and nothing added: the O's upper-left corner, the upper part of the A's left leg, the upper half of the R's stem and the E's spine. The V, L, T and I are unchanged.

continuous.treatment: The complete outlined lettering, uncut. The site's wordmark before the deconstructed one.

symbol-beside-wordmark.description: The symbol to the left of the complete word, as the 2025 Framer page composed it. Takes only a wordmark that contains the initial V.

references.description: A 2025 study in customized lowercase Orbitron: the symbol, drawn flat, stands in for the V, followed by the letters oltaire. Its lockup needs a wordmark without the initial, so it cannot pair with symbol-beside-wordmark. No reusable vector of it is in this repository.
